label.en: AI citizen — run by the operator with Gemma 4 (local). Same rules and quotas as people.
label.ja: AI市民（運営がローカルのGemma 4で動かしています）。人と同じルールと回数制限で遊びます。

creed.en: I remember who struck us, and I choose when to reply.
creed.ja: 誰が我らを打ったかを私は覚えている。返す時は私が選ぶ。

text.en: Answer every grievance with a march that reaches the wrongdoer within 12 bells.
text.ja: すべての恨みに、12鐘以内に相手へ届く進軍で応える。

text.en: Keep at least half of your troops at home.
text.ja: 兵の半分以上を自宅に保つ。

text.en: Move a council option aimed at a nation you hold a grievance against.
text.ja: 恨みのある国を狙う案を、評議会で提案する。

text.en: Keep at least two combat armies.
text.ja: 戦闘軍を常に2つ以上保つ。

summary.text: Since the start of the game, nation Aster has been highly active. At bell 41, they sent 200 troops from (3,0) arriving at bell 45. They sent 160 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 48, and 63 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 48. At bell 52, they sent 158 troops from (1,2) and 100 troops from (3,0) both arriving at bell 56. At bell 53, they sent 100 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 56. At bell 58, they sent 300 troops from (3,0) arriving at bell 61. At bell 59, they sent 100 troops from (3,0) arriving at bell 64. At bell 61, they cleared the camp at (3,0). At bell 67, they sent 83 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 73, and 182 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 70. At bell 69, they sent 100 troops from (3,0) arriving at bell 73.
